# PocketSmart AI

PocketSmart AI is a GenAI-powered budget and recommendation assistant.

It provides personalized planning for:

- Home interiors
- Party/event planning
- Jewelry recommendations

## Technology

- Python
- FastAPI
- Jinja2
- SQLite
- Google Gemini
- JavaScript
- HTML
- CSS
- JWT authentication
- Pytest

## Features

### Home Planner

Users provide:

- Budget
- Rooms
- Item quantities
- Interior style
- Preferences

The AI generates:

- Budget allocation
- Product recommendations
- Estimated prices
- Platform search links
- Shopping tips

### Party Planner

Users provide:

- Budget
- Guest count
- Event type
- Venue
- Preferences

The system generates:

- Food budget
- Venue allocation
- Decoration budget
- Supplies
- Contingency

### Jewelry Planner

Users provide:

- Budget
- Occasion
- Style
- Outfit description
- Optional outfit image

The system generates:

- Jewelry recommendations
- Estimated prices
- Style reasoning
- Platform search links

## Authentication

The application provides:

- Registration
- Login
- Logout
- JWT token endpoint
- HTTP-only authentication cookie
- Session information
